row.name: Psychometry
row.effect: By touching an object with a strong, recent history, you gain vague sensory hints of its past for 1 minute.

levels.name: Psychometry
levels.description: The Force-user can perceive echoes of the past by touching an object or entering a location where strong emotions or significant events have occurred.
levels.effect: By touching an object with a strong, recent history, you gain vague sensory hints of its past for 1 minute.

levels.name: Psychometry
levels.description: The Force-user can perceive echoes of the past by touching an object or entering a location where strong emotions or significant events have occurred.
levels.effect: Gain clearer impressions and specific details from objects with a significant history for up to 5 minutes.

levels.name: Psychometry
levels.description: The Force-user can perceive echoes of the past by touching an object or entering a location where strong emotions or significant events have occurred.
levels.effect: Project your senses into past events you perceive, experiencing them as if present for up to 10 minutes.

levels.name: Psychometry
levels.description: The Force-user can perceive echoes of the past by touching an object or entering a location where strong emotions or significant events have occurred.
levels.effect: Witness any event related to a person or location by concentrating on them, even without direct physical contact, for up to 30 minutes.
